title: Hive Protocol BTC-staking (BSquared) — contracts located, E-U $0
closed_reasons: staking payouts are per-user and stake-bounded; withdraw takes only pid, amount comes from the caller's own accounting
withdraw requires a matured unstake request (fork-proven: no unstake -> 0 payout; over-unstake reverts 'Not enough staking token balance')
vault deposit/withdraw/transferToStaking require msg.sender == strategies[pid] (fork-proven revert 'no permission')
strategy manager withdraw is caller-whitelisted (fork-proven revert 'no permission to call')
B2-staking withdraw/requestWithdrawals are request+balance+lockup gated; admin fns onlyOwner
34 unprivileged probes on the staking contract moved 0 wei (aggregate staking+vault delta 0)

fork test: 34 unprivileged function probes (fe92e060, 75c717ef, fb2d64b1, 514c25c3, setVault, setB2, pauseWithdraw, grantRole, upgradeToAndCall, ...) -> aggregate staking/vault delta 0

caveats: not all ADMIN_ROLE holders enumerated (mapping not enumerable); two single-EOA upgrade authorities identified via the upgrade txs
total user accounting not summed, so holder-attribution of the full 3476.71 BTC is an assumption; E-U=$0 does not depend on it
BSquared has no reachable verified-source explorer (explorer /api/v2 404, Sourcify 404, Etherscan-V2 unsupported chainid) -> all logic recovered by heimdall decompilation and confirmed by fork tests
categories are not additive: the same custodied BTC is reachable by the privileged (P) upgrade path
point-in-time 2026-10-25; no transaction signed or sent
one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Hive Protocol (BSquared); the 3,476.71 BTC (~$279.9M) is holder-recoverable but every value/admin path is request-bounded or role-gated (17/17 fork tests), so the finding is code-clear; the material residual is a single-EOA UUPS upgrade authority (P).
